title: Wayback Machine archive monitoring: extend social.md daily run to verify Wayback snapshot presence/age for dome + review URLs, alert on removal or extended staleness. Companion to the operator-triggered save-baseline landed 2026-07-09T18:13-18:28Z.

context.why_now: Operator observation 2026-07-09: neither the dome model site (john09289.github.io/predictions) nor our review site (funwithscience.net/dome-model-review) were on the Internet Archive. Operator triggered Save Page Now for 14 canonical URLs during today's cowork session (see baseline_snapshots below) — that establishes the initial third-party archive. The gap this directive closes: (a) alert if any snapshot gets REMOVED (Wayback accepts removal requests from site owners; the dome author is a plausible requester), (b) alert if the newest snapshot ages past a threshold without a fresh save (we're not actively re-saving on every dome change, so long-drift means our archive is behind live), (c) track snapshot count over time as a monitoring signal for coverage growth or attrition.
context.why_social_not_poller: Poller's job is detecting live-site changes on the dome. Wayback monitoring is a read-only availability check adjacent to social's existing discoverability domain (llms.txt, sitemap, GSC verification, search rankings). Adding it here matches the domain and reuses social's daily 04:30 UTC cadence.
context.why_not_automated_save: The Save Page Now (SPN2) endpoint accepts anonymous POSTs but requires ~30-90s per URL, a realistic User-Agent, and follow-redirects. Scheduled agents doing this at scale would trip Wayback rate limits from the sandbox's fixed IP block and would degrade their run budgets. Save-triggering stays operator-side (cowork session) or is deferred entirely. This directive is READ-ONLY monitoring, not save-triggering.

not_saved_this_pass: ai_manifest.json, llms.txt, api/*.json — machine-readable layer; JSON URLs may need a separate SPN pass. Consider in follow-up if operator wants coverage.

part_A_add_availability_check_to_social.shape: Extend social.md daily run with a new pass: 'Wayback Archive Presence Verification'. For each URL in a maintained MONITORED_URLS list (initially the 14 above), call `https://archive.org/wayback/available?url=<url>` (JSON API, no auth) and record: (a) archived (true/false), (b) closest snapshot URL, (c) closest snapshot timestamp. Emit findings when: (i) archived flips from true → false (removal); (ii) newest snapshot age exceeds a threshold (default 90 days) suggesting we should re-run the operator save-baseline; (iii) API is unreachable (log as UNKNOWN, do not alarm).
part_A_add_availability_check_to_social.monitored_urls_list_location: Store as a top-of-social.md const or in a small config file at monitor/social/wayback-monitored-urls.json — operator-editable. Include all 14 baseline URLs. Add new dome pages as they appear in poller changes.
part_A_add_availability_check_to_social.cadence: Daily inside the existing social 04:30 UTC run. Cost: 14 HTTP GETs to a public JSON API — negligible.
part_A_add_availability_check_to_social.reporting: Add a Wayback section to social's daily report (monitor/social/report-YYYY-MM-DD.json) with a wayback_status object: {monitored_url_count, all_archived, oldest_snapshot_age_days, newest_snapshot_age_days, removal_alerts, staleness_alerts}. If any alerts fire, also add an entry to author_activity[] with platform:'wayback', signal:<alert type>, evidence:<URL + snapshot ts>.

part_B_operator_save_reminder.why: Since we're not auto-saving on every dome change, snapshots go stale relative to live. Establish a re-save cadence.
part_B_operator_save_reminder.shape: In the same Wayback section: if the newest snapshot for any monitored URL is >90 days old, emit a moderate finding recommending an operator re-save session. Include the SPN command template (`curl -sSL -A <UA> --max-time 120 https://web.archive.org/save/<url>`) in the finding body so the operator can copy-paste.
part_B_operator_save_reminder.threshold_rationale: 90 days matches the dome author's typical version-bump cadence (V13 → V51.1 across ~2 years ≈ one bump per ~19 days on average, but the author has been in a manual-commit drought at d=83 as of today so a 90-day re-save floor is conservative).

part_C_do_not_auto_save.constraint: This directive is READ-ONLY monitoring only. Social must NOT attempt Save Page Now from its scheduled run. Rationale: SPN needs 30-90s per URL, a realistic UA, IP-rate-limit avoidance, and would consume most of social's daily budget on save-side latency. Re-saves stay operator-triggered from cowork sessions. If tinker's design proposes auto-saving, the operator will veto — this constraint is non-negotiable in the initial ship.

deliverable_acceptance_criteria: One PROP authored proposing the social.md addition + optionally the wayback-monitored-urls.json config file.

Verification pattern grade B minimum: fixture-test that (a) an archived URL returns archived:true, (b) an unarchived URL (e.g. a fresh test URL) returns archived:false, (c) API unreachable returns UNKNOWN not alarm.
PROP includes explicit not-in-scope: no auto-save.
First actual run of the check happens on social's next 04:30 UTC cycle after ship. Expected: all 14 baseline URLs return archived:true, no alerts fire.

constraints.no_auto_save: See Part C. Operator veto in advance.
constraints.read_only_api_calls_only: Availability API is public + rate-lenient. CDX search API is also public but returns more data — use only if availability API is insufficient.
constraints.not_a_poller_task: Poller detects dome-site changes; social does discoverability/machine-layer monitoring. Wayback presence is discoverability-adjacent. Do NOT propose moving this to poller.

background_artifacts.wayback_availability_api_docs: https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php — 'Wayback Machine API Availability' endpoint: GET https://archive.org/wayback/available?url=<url>&timestamp=<optional>. Returns JSON: {url, archived_snapshots: {closest: {status, available, url, timestamp}} | {}}. No auth, no rate limit for reasonable use.
background_artifacts.cdx_api_docs: https://archive.org/help/wayback_api.php — CDX Server returns full snapshot history. Consider if we want snapshot COUNT over time (monotonic growth check) — availability API only returns the closest, not the count.

not_in_scope: Do NOT auto-trigger Save Page Now from any scheduled agent (see Part C).
Do NOT add Wayback checking to poller (see Part D constraint).
Do NOT extend to non-dome, non-review sites (e.g. don't try to archive the whole InternetArchive/Wayback ecosystem).
Do NOT modify the archived snapshots themselves (this is public infrastructure, we consume only).
operator_notes: Operator (Steve, 2026-07-09 cowork): 'is the dome site on the internet archive?' → answer was NO for both dome and review → operator triggered manual Save Page Now for 14 URLs → this directive commissions the monitoring layer. Small directive; probably one social.md prompt-edit PROP + one config file. Priority medium — not urgent, but the alerting side matters (removal request would be a strong signal about the dome author's engagement state).
